headline: US futures point to a mixed open as tech lags ahead of heavy earnings, key labor data and Fed speeches
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) fall 0.11%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) climb 0.45%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) drop 0.76%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) rise 0.28%, signaling a mixed open with relative weakness in technology
- Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) trades roughly flat pre-market after cutting 2026 guidance and warning of a 2027 EPS decline despite a Q3 beat
- Amdocs (DOX) trades roughly flat in early trading after cutting its FY27 outlook on a contractual T-Mobile dispute, as Oppenheimer downgrades the shares
- Nurix Therapeutics (NRIX) rises about 3.5% pre-market after Sanofi terminates its STAT6 degrader program and analysts cut price targets
- Estee Lauder (EL) trades roughly flat in pre-market after analysts raise price targets following a fiscal Q1 beat and new 2030 financial goals, while Rivian (RIVN) slips modestly
- Parker-Hannifin (PH), Cigna (CI), Cummins (CMI), Duke Energy (DUK), Zoetis (ZTS), and Rockwell Automation (ROK) report earnings before the opening bell, with initial share price reactions already visible
- At 8:30 AM ET, investors will receive initial jobless claims, continuing claims, nonfarm productivity, and unit labor costs data
- Federal Reserve officials Hammack and Barkin are scheduled to deliver speeches later in the morning
- European equities edge higher while major Asian indexes trade mixed overnight
- Oil (@CL) holds near recent lower levels while gold (@GC) prices move higher in early trading
